sources.longTerm: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 82(2) table: the long-term rows (G + P, G + P + 0.7S); the others short-term
sources.concrete: BSL EO Art. 91 and AIJ RC Standard Art. 6: compression Fc/3 long-term, 2Fc/3 short-term; shear fs = min(Fc/30, 0.49 + Fc/100) long-term, × 1.5 short-term; n = 15 (AIJ RC Standard Art. 5, for Fc up to 27 MPa: SAEngine takes 15 for every grade, see VERIFY.md); j = 7/8 d
sources.rebar: BSL EO Art. 90 and AIJ RC Standard Art. 6: long-term ft and fc of the main bars SR235 155, SD295 195, SD345/SD390/SD490 215 (195 for D29 and larger), short-term F; shear reinforcement wft 195 long-term (SR235 155), F short-term (SD490: see VERIFY.md)
sources.shear: AIJ RC Standard 2018 Art. 15: Qa = b j (α fs + 0.5 wft (pw - 0.002)) short-term, b j α fs long-term, α = 4 / (M/(Q d) + 1), 1 <= α <= 2 (beams), 1.5 (columns), pw at most 1.2 %
